description: Looks inside a PDF or Word file for data that a reader does not see and a recipient can still extract: text under a covering shape, unapplied redactions, invisible text, document properties, older revisions, attachments, comments and tracked changes. Excerpts come back masked. The file is sent to Redactic in the EU and is not stored.

path.description: Full path of the PDF or .docx file.

name: check_file
title: Check a file for hidden data
